channel.title: Campaign Producers Insights
channel.description: Practical thinking on campaign strategy, microdrama, AI production and smarter production decisions.

item.title: Creator content is not a shortcut to brand effect
item.description: Creator work can win attention and still leave the brand behind. The answer is not tighter control. It is a clearer campaign job, better rights planning and measurement that goes beyond engagement.

item.title: AI, traditional or hybrid? Start with the campaign job.
item.description: The most expensive production mistake is choosing the method before deciding what the campaign must make people notice, feel or do.
